headline: Texas Instruments posts AMS verification role for a Bengaluru high-voltage power team
fact: Texas Instruments posted an AMS verification engineer/lead role describing a high-voltage power team being built in Bengaluru for AC/DC controllers, isolated DC/DC converters, and GaN-integrated power stages. The role calls for SV-RNM and Verilog-AMS wreal/electrical models, system-level AMS tests, SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, assertions and coverage, methodology development, and participation in post-silicon validation and debug.

sources.title: Texas Instruments: AMS Design Verification Lead — Mixed-Signal SoC / GaN
sources.summary: The company-attributed LinkedIn posting names a TI recruiter and describes the Bengaluru HVP hiring mandate. Its structured datePosted is June 22, 2026; this dates the public posting, rather than conflicting dates on secondary copies or completion of the described team build-out.
